acquisition_method: The DDA mode was performed with the following parameters: the full scan range was 350 – 1’150m/z at 120’000 resolutions.
alkylation_concentration: alkylated with 20 mM Iodoacetamide (30 minutes, 37°C and 200 rpm)
alkylation_reagent: alkylated with 20 mM Iodoacetamide (30 minutes, 37°C and 200 rpm)
cleavage_agent: The beads were resuspended in 203 µL 100 mM ABC containing 1 µg of trypsin (Promega) and 0.5 µg of LysC (FUJIFLM Wako) for overnight digestion (37°C, 200 rpm).
collision_energy: Fragmentation was obtained with HCD collision energy 30%.
enrichment_method: Next, the treated lysate was added to 80 µL of Strep-Tactin beads (50% slurry, IBA Lifesciences) previously modified to be resistant to tryptic cleavage (reference: Mol Syst Biol(2020)16: e9370https://doi.org/10.15252/msb.20199370) followed by incubation of the samples on a rotating wheel for 1 hour at 4°C.
fragmentation_method: Fragmentation was obtained with HCD collision energy 30%.
ionization_type: inferred: Samples were injected into a Waters nanoACQUITY coupled to an Orbitrap Fusion Lumos.
labeling: inferred: The peptides were separated on a 30 cm column packed with 3 µm C18 resin (Dr. Maisch) by a 120 min gradient from 3% to 35% buffer B (100% ACN containing 0.1% FA) at a flow rate of 300 nL/min.
mass_analyzer: inferred: Samples were injected into a Waters nanoACQUITY coupled to an Orbitrap Fusion Lumos.
reduction_concentration: reduced with 10 mM TCEP (40 minutes, 37°C and 200 rpm)
reduction_reagent: reduced with 10 mM TCEP (40 minutes, 37°C and 200 rpm)
